system.concept: Tremere Council representative and secretly unraveling elder
system.biography:
Background

Taken from a peasant life by a mortal prince who abused and eventually Embraced her out of drunken spite, Carna became the first female @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} and rose to become Prince of Marseille before the Clan sent her to watch over its secret investigation of Milwaukee's magical "null zone" at Marquette University. She holds Milwaukee's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} seat on the Council of Elders, but the real authority over the Clan's local operation rests with her subordinate, the assassin Victor, who reports to her only what she needs to know. Over 600 years old and repeating the same doomed pattern of love and violence with every lover she takes (she has developed a ritual, Curse of Clytaemnestra, expressly to destroy those who spurn her), Carna is growing tired of the endless Jyhad and has quietly begun to question the Tremere Clan's demands of her — a dangerous line of thought for any Tremere.

Roleplaying Hints

Flirtatious and sultry with male characters while secretly scheming to dominate everyone in the room. When finally pushed into open conflict, drop the warmth entirely and show the cold-blooded killer underneath.
system.notes: Sire: the Prince Bourdona. Haven: several, favoring a suite in the Hyatt Regency. Disciplines as printed: Auspex 4, Dominate 5, Thaumaturgy 5 (capped above to this system's 1-5 scale). Rituals: Defense of Sacred Haven, Wake with Evening's Freshness, Deflection of Wooden Doom, Ritual of Darkness, Curse of Clytaemnestra (the last two her own creations).

system.description:
The Sielanic practitioner raises a spectral troop of mindless dead, called Drones, to act as defenders or to deliver warnings to her enemies. Though the tattered, ethereal images of long-dead warriors cannot fully materialize, they can hurl objects and frighten attackers. The ghosts return to their rest at the end of the night on which they are summoned.

System: This power costs two blood points and a Willpower roll (difficulty 7). The number of successes determines how many Drones the Cainite can summon.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers

items.name: Thaumaturgy — 3 Advanced — Walk the Road of Shadows

system.description:
This power lets the vampire physically cross the barrier between the world of the living and the Underworld (Shadowlands) for a brief time, appearing to its denizens as a particularly solid wraith. She can interact freely with wraiths there, though she has no control over how they regard her, and any resulting combat causes real damage to both parties. Sielanic priests sometimes use this power to transport mortals into the Underworld as part of a shamanic initiation rite.

System: This power costs three blood points and two Willpower, and requires a Willpower roll (difficulty 8). A single success lets the Cainite penetrate the Shroud and enter the Underworld; three successes let her bring one other person along. She may remain until dawn forces her out, until she flees, or until driven out by the Underworld's residents.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
system.duration: Until dawn or the caster's choice

system.description: When issuing a Dominate command, spend a Blood Trait and decide how many future attempts to resist or recover memories you wish to crush, spending one Mental Trait per attempt (these Traits are unavailable the rest of the night, though Willpower expenditure restores them normally). If the subject tries to disobey or recover memories within that limit, agonizing pain incapacitates him for 10 minutes; the power fades once all guarded attempts have been used.
system.bloodCost: One Blood Trait, plus one Mental Trait per resisted attempt crushed
system.duration: Until the set number of resistance attempts are exhausted

system.description: Spend a Willpower Trait and win a normal Mental Challenge against a familiar target, regardless of distance, to establish mental contact as though eye contact had been made. Once contact is established, Dominate may be used on the subject normally; using this against another supernatural being costs an additional Willpower Trait.
system.bloodCost: One Willpower Trait (plus one more against supernaturals)
system.duration: As per the Dominate power used

system.description: By winning a Mental Challenge and concentrating for a turn, you establish a telepathic link with a visible subject, allowing thought communication and the extraction of certain truthful answers, with deeper secrets costing a Mental Trait per question.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: As long as contact is maintained

system.description: By touching an object and concentrating for a turn while spending a Mental Trait, you glimpse psychic impressions of powerful emotional events tied to it, possibly suffering a temporary derangement from particularly traumatic echoes.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

vtmlarp.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred
